annotations.title: Investment Services and Wealth Management | Chase
Chase Capital Services (P) Ltd - Business Grows With Us

content.text:
Do you mean **“Chase Capital Services”** as a company, a charge on your account, or a message/call you received?

A quick distinction:

- **Chase / JPMorgan Chase** offers banking, credit cards, business services, auto dealer services, and investing through **J.P. Morgan Wealth Management**. ([chase.com](https://www.chase.com/personal/investments?utm_source=openai))
- **Chase Capital Services (P) Ltd** appears to be a separate India-based financial consultancy company founded in 1997; it is **not obviously the same as Chase Bank/JPMorgan Chase** from the search result. ([chasecapital.in](https://www.chasecapital.in/aboutus.html?utm_source=openai))
- If you saw “Chase Capital Services” in an email, phone call, loan offer, or account charge, be cautious and verify directly through the official Chase app/website or the phone number on the back of your Chase card—don’t use links or numbers from the message.

If you tell me where you saw the phrase—**bank statement, email, text, job offer, loan offer, or website**—I can help you figure out whether it’s legitimate.
